module.description: Implement a Mealy Finite-State Machine (FSM) detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.

ports.input: Clock signal used for synchronous operation.
Reset signal to initialize the FSM.
ports.output: Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.

parameter_description.parameter: State detecting 2th bit 0. This case is check sequences with successive bits `1, 0, 0, 1, 1` such: 1, 0, 0, 1, `1, 0, 0, 1, 1`.

logic_description.description: Notice that below descriptions are along with tags <logic />. With a <logic type="combinational_logic" />, must construct this logic as interal wire declaration. Or this <logic type="combinational_logic" /> can be declared as a `reg` but only be used in always(*) block. With a <logic type="sequential_logic" />, must construct this logic as `reg` declaration. Must update this logic, in an always block, based on other <logic type="sequential_logic" /> or <logic type="combinational_logic" /> states. With a <logic type="sequential_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just place this operation sequence in below mentioned description. With a <logic type="combinational_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just based on the keyword `assign` to construct description of this combinational logic operation.
logic_description.logic: If RST is active, the output signal MATCH is set to 0. Otherwise, `MATCH` is active if the current state `ST_cr` is `s4` and the input `IN` is active.
This logic updates FSM state based on `ST_nt`. Based on positive `CLK` and positive `RST`, if `RST` is active, `ST_cr` is `s0`, else `ST_cr` is `ST_nt`.

This logic selects next state of FSM based on the input `IN`. In case `ST_cr` is `s0`, `ST_nt` is `s0`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s1`. In case `ST_cr` is `s1`, `ST_nt` is `s2`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s1`. In case `ST_cr` is `s2`, `ST_nt` is `s3`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s1`. In case `ST_cr` is `s3`, `ST_nt` is `s0`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s4`. In case `ST_cr` is `s4`, `ST_nt` is `s2`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s5`. In case `ST_cr` is `s5`, `ST_nt` is `s2`, if `IN` is zero, else `ST_nt` is `s1`.

module.implementation: The module implements an FSM detection. Please make sure that you perform the `Logic description` correctly.
